extension.summary: Films and TV with Trakt, TMDB and Premiumize
extension.description: SpongeTV brings Trakt syncing, TMDB metadata, Premiumize and your own provider packages together in one add-on. This is a stage 4 test build: browsing, metadata, Trakt, provider packages and playback through Premiumize.
extension.disclaimer: SpongeTV includes no content providers. You are responsible for the provider packages you install.
extension.news: 0.4.2: Tools, Accounts shows your Premiumize premium days left, not how long the sign-in lasts. 0.4.1: Sign in to Premiumize with a code, as in Seren: Tools, Accounts (or Settings, Accounts), then enter the code at premiumize.me/device. The setup wizard offers it too. The Premiumize API key and the Trakt Client ID and Secret move to the Expert settings level. 0.4.0: Playback. Add your Premiumize API key in Settings, Accounts. Sources show Ready, In your cloud or Not cached, and your Premiumize cloud is searched too. Pressing play offers to resume, then plays the best source (Auto Play) or shows Source Select, set separately for films and episodes; a source that won't play moves on to the next. Season packs play the right episode. SpongeTV scrobbles to Trakt, keeps its own resume points and clears Kodi's, so you see one resume prompt. Smart Play gets the next episode ready, Playing Next offers Play now or Stop after this episode, and Still Watching asks after a few episodes in a row. Shows have Play next episode in their context menu. 0.3.0: Sources. Install provider packages (Seren format) from a web address, a zip file or the built-in test provider; turn providers on and off, change package settings, update, roll back and uninstall them (Tools, Providers and sources). Pressing play now searches every provider at once in SpongeTV's progress window, with early stop and Choose from N found, then opens Source Select with filters, sort rules you can reorder, and Info to see why a source is where it is. New Sources settings. Playback itself arrives in stage 4. 0.2.7: Seasons show how many aired episodes you've watched in their name, such as Season 1 (7/10), so it appears in every view and sort order. 0.2.6: SpongeTV's Trakt Client ID is built in, so signing in only needs the code at trakt.tv/activate. You can still use your own Trakt app in Settings, Accounts. 0.2.5: Your own and liked Trakt lists are read fresh each time, so lists created, deleted or changed on trakt.tv show straight away. 0.2.4: Trending and Popular lists, and big lists, now open quickly: they load a page at a time with a Next page item. Adding to or removing from a list shows straight away. 0.2.3: Upcoming and Recent episodes start each line with when it airs or aired, in your time zone (Today 21:00, Tomorrow 02:00, Sat 14 Nov 20:00). 0.2.2: In Next up, Upcoming episodes and Recent episodes the show name now uses your Highlight colour ("No highlight" keeps it plain). 0.2.1: Fixed watched episodes not downloading from Trakt (Trakt now sends seasons only when asked), which left Next up and Shows in progress empty. Your watch history downloads again in full on the next sync. Next up now says why when it's empty. 0.2.0: Trakt. Sign in with a code on trakt.tv; My films, My TV shows with Next up, shows in progress, upcoming and recent episodes, recommendations and Trakt lists; watched marks, resume points and season progress; Trakt actions on every title (watched, collection, watchlist, favourites, lists, rate, hide, clear resume point); background sync of only what changed; Trakt sync in Tools. 0.1.4: Advanced artwork sizes now sit directly under Artwork quality, with no empty heading left behind. 0.1.3: One search for films, TV shows and people; actors' and directors' pages; related titles and cast (context menu); TV networks, new shows and streaming services; sortable lists; hide options per menu; customisable home menu; episode title styles; highlight colour; Advanced artwork sizes; API keys checked when entered; grouped Tools with Clear all caches. 0.1.2: Fixed search, genres and years. 0.1.1: The setup wizard asks for your own TMDB key. 0.1.0: First Stage 1 test build.
